evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3581257 ($499.96, product R, online) scores 0.03 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.66.
Card baseline from 5013 earlier transactions: median $116.91, 95th percentile $963.21; the flagged amount is 4.3x the median.
Device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1024x768' was used by this card before; identity record marks it New.

Structuring: 4 online purchases between $499.96 and $499.96 within 59 minutes, each just under a $500 threshold, from 2 device profiles marked New. The bank's closed cases record the same shape five times (CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4086, CC-4124), all confirmed fraud and filed as undocumented. Measured on July-October, such bursts are fraud 9 times in 41 (likelihood ratio ~8).
Simulated customer validation: Cardholder confirms they made the transaction.
Policy R3: Customer confirms the transaction: CLOSE_NO_FRAUD, with the confirmation noted in the case file.

Policy §3a: A case is opened at probability 0.30, on any evidence request, or on any dispute; a report is filed only when fraud is confirmed or strongly suspected and exposure exceeds $1,000, the activity connects to a shared device, region or another customer's fraud, or the pattern is coordinated or undocumented.

case.summary: Alert on transaction 3581257 ($499.96) on card C02716-K2. The graph evidence does not support fraud: the transaction is consistent with the holder's own history, and the calibrated model puts it at 0.02. Cardholder confirms they made the transaction. Closed as legitimate; no report.
